voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json).
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.

fire.prompt: Rapid burst from a heavy sci-fi needle pulse gatling energy weapon: a fast buzzing stream of thin sharp energy pulses, crackling electric snaps and laser zaps with a whining spin-up and spin-down, no gunpowder, no bullets, close, outdoors battlefield, no music, no voice

fire_flame.prompt: Sci-fi plasma jet torch blast: a sharp electric ignition snap bursting into a roaring rushing stream of searing plasma, an intense electric hiss and buzzing crackle of arcing energy, like a giant plasma cutter, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Big six-legged alien war machine scuttling forward: fast heavy hydraulic legs clattering in quick rhythm, metal claws thudding into dirt, servo whine and pneumatic hiss, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Heavy legged alien war machine destroyed: a fiery metal explosion with fuel bursting, crackling electric arcs discharging, a dying synthetic drone sliding down in pitch, legs collapsing and the hull crashing to the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
